about: Every shipped document (anything under assets/certificates/ and every PDF) after someone looked at it for personal data, pinned by sha256. tests/site.test.mjs fails when a document ships unreviewed or changes after review. Decision 'public': fine to publish as it is. Decision 'redact': holds data the owner may not mean to publish; it is also registered in web/known-issues.json. Name the kinds of data in notes, never the values: this repository is public.

reviewed.notes: Name, course, teacher's name, issue month, hours, QR code and certificate code. Normal for a verifiable certificate.
